name: Longer Nano Pro 12W
tagline: Fast portable Longer : 12W with high traverse and rotary options
tldr: Longer Nano Pro 12W is a premium portable diode with very high advertised speeds and rotary/slide accessories. Niche machine for makers who need portability with more punch than 6W minis.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Step up from Nano with more engraving speed in the same compact class
Still portable compared with Ray5 or B1 frames
Useful for craft fairs and small personalized goods
cons: Bed size limits sign and panel work
Open-frame exhaust needed even for small jobs
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 12W SKU on Longer Nano Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.

editorialDepth.advantages: Nano Pro 12W bridges toy-class engravers and full-size diodes. You gain workable speeds on wood and leather gifts without dedicating half a desk.
editorialDepth.limitations: When you quote cut-out shapes to customers, move to Ray5 20W. Not comparable to enclosed apartment machines for smoke control.
